correctness.rationale: Seven nonempty color supports for the nonhub clique vertices and three leaf-relative colors exhaust every initial state up to a global color rotation. The 21-case transition classification follows from the original open-neighborhood update, and yields both the sharp iterate \(F^5=F^2\) and exact first-entry labels. Inclusion-exclusion gives \(Q_r\), all six counts summing to \(3^{r+2}\), and orbit-specific sizes nine and \(3(2^{r+1}-1)\). The proof holds for every integer \(r\ge2\). A separate 21-class checker and a separate vertex-by-vertex direct C++ simulation of 2,391,471 labelled states corroborate, but do not replace, the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The minimal nontrivial one-leaf perturbation of the complete interaction graph turns every formerly immediate fully three-colored clique cycle into three equal temporal entrance layers, each primitive \(3\)-cycle having exactly nine labelled initial states in its basin, independent of graph size. This is a motivated complete attraction-basin classification for a natural infinite family and explains a sharp difference between core periodicity and full-network periodicity. The exact equal conditional onset law and per-orbit basin uniformity are not generic consequences of the prior irrotationality criterion.
